item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumors May Explain Doctor Doom's Powers & Tony Stark-Like Appearance - SPOILERS
item.description: Some intriguing new rumors relating to Doctor Doom's (Robert Downey Jr.) role in Avengers: Doomsday are doing the rounds online. Beware of potential spoilers ahead...

item.title: AVENGERS: SECRET WARS Rumor Reveals Spider-Man Plans And [SPOILER]'s "Big" Role
item.description: The latest Avengers: Secret Wars rumour reveals Marvel Studios plans for the three Spider-Men, as well as a certain Merc with a Mouth, Ryan Reynolds' Deadpool.

item.title: PROJECT HAIL MARY Super Bowl TV Spot Released; New LEGO Set Turns Ryan Gosling Into A Minifigure
item.description: A new trailer for Project Hail Mary will be released on Sunday, and in the meantime, we have a Big Game TV spot preview, along with a LEGO set featuring Ryan Gosling, Rocky, and The Hail Mary.

item.title: DC Studios' Super Bowl Plans For SUPERGIRL Continue A Disappointing Trend Set By SUPERMAN
item.description: DC Studios is skipping the Super Bowl this weekend, and a new Supergirl promo confirms that the DCU movie will follow a similar path to last summer's Superman.

item.title: ERAGON Live-Action Series Moves Forward At Disney+ With TASM's Marc Webb As Executive Producer
item.description: It's been a while since we had any updates on the live-action Eragon series, but the project is now moving ahead at Disney+ with new showrunners and exec producers on board...

item.title: DOOMQUEST 10-Issue Comic Arrives This May; Billed As A "Quintessential" Doctor Doom Epic
item.description: This May, Marvel Comics is launching Doomquest, a ten-issue series that promises to get new and returning fans up to speed on all things Doctor Doom before his lead role in Avengers: Doomsday.

item.title: William Shatner Brilliantly Defends Modern STAR TREK Against Elon Musk
item.description: William Shatner responded to Elon Musk’s criticism of modern Star Trek, using franchise canon to explain why today’s darker stories still fit its long-standing message of hope and progress.
